#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <algorithm>

using namespace std;

const long long MOD = 998244353;

long long modExp(long long x, long long y) {
    long long res = 1;
    while (y > 0) {
        if (y & 1) res = res * x % MOD;
        x = x * x % MOD;
        y >>= 1;
    }
    return res;
}

int main() {
    int n, m, k;
    cin >> n >> m >> k;
    int maxJ = min(n, k);
    vector<vector<long long>> dp(k + 1, vector<long long>(maxJ + 1, 0));
    dp[0][0] = 1;
    for (int i = 1; i <= k; i++) {
        for (int j = 1; j <= maxJ; j++) {
            dp[i][j] = (dp[i][j] + dp[i-1][j] * j % MOD) % MOD;
            dp[i][j] = (dp[i][j] + dp[i-1][j-1] * (n - j + 1) % MOD) % MOD;
        }
    }
    long long invm = modExp(m, MOD - 2);
    long long res = 0;
    long long prob = 1;
    for (int i = 0; i <= maxJ; i++) {
        res = (res + dp[k][i] * prob % MOD) % MOD;
        prob = prob * invm % MOD;
    }
    cout << res << endl;
    return 0;
}
